nameOrigin: one who has returned from the dead

pokedexEntries.x: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

pokedexEntries.or: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

pokedexEntries.y: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

pokedexEntries.as: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

pokedexEntries.su: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.

pokedexEntries.mo: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

pokedexEntries.us: It’s feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

pokedexEntries.um: This Pokémon controls trees via roots stretching from its feet, and it will attack anyone that dares to ravage the forest.

pokedexEntries.sw: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

pokedexEntries.sh: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.
